body: From the stage-2 back-test: fraud judgment signals stay hard at entry; auditor exit/RBI divergence/SEC non-reliance/delayed results become exit triggers; pledge graded (escalate >50% or rising); CFO/PAT, negative FCF, other income become questions not flags; P/E moves to valuation. Solvency set added but untested — test before relying on it.
title: Adopt disqualifiers v2 provisionally (hard at entry vs hard at exit vs graded vs questions)
